custodian of the stolen plans that can save her people and restore freedom to the galaxy....|[[Journal of the Whills]]|{{StoryCite|story=Whills (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View}}}} The '''secret mission to Tatooine''' was an operation undertaken in [[1 BBY]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. The mission followed the [[Battle of Scarif|Rebellion's theft]] of the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[planet]]-destroying deep [[Realspace|space]] mobile [[battle station]] from the planet [[Scarif]]. Rebel [[Spy|spies]] [[Jyn Erso]] and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] transmitted the plans to [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]] aboard his [[flagship]]. As the battle concluded, the plans were nearly reclaimed by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], but were successfully transferred to [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan]] aboard the ''[[Tantive IV]]''. After escaping into [[hyperspace]], Organa's [[CR90 corvette|corvette]] was pursued by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator]]'' to the planet [[Tatooine]], beginning the '''Assault on ''Tantive IV'''''. In the fierce battle in [[orbit]] between the ''Tantive IV'' and the ''Devastator'', the corvette was no match for the immense ''Devastator'' and was captured and boarded by [[Stormtrooper|Imperial troops]], led by [[Darth]] Vader, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]]. Organa herself was [[stun]]ned and captured but not before she uploaded the plans to the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] who, along with his [[protocol droid]] companion [[C-3PO]], escaped to Tatooine aboard an [[escape pod]]. Artoo's mission was to find [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], for whom the droid had a [[Hologram|holographic]] message from the princess. Once on the surface, the two droids came into the possession of a group of [[Jawa]] [[scavenger]]s before being sold to [[moisture farm]]er [[Owen Lars]] and his nephew, [[Luke Skywalker]]. The Empire, meanwhile, learned that the droids were likely in possession of the stolen plans and searched the planet for them. Artoo fled from the [[Lars homestead|Lars moisture farm]] in search of Kenobi. The message, which Artoo delivered to Kenobi with Skywalker's assistance, was the princess' plea for help, asking that the Jedi Master safely deliver the plans to [[Bail Prestor Organa]], one of the founders of the Rebel Alliance, on Alderaan. When the Empire learned that the droids had been sold to the Lars family, they [[Death|killed]] Owen and his [[Marriage|wife]], [[Beru Whitesun Lars|Beru Lars]]. His family having been killed, Skywalker agreed to leave with Kenobi and take the droids to Alderaan. They hired a [[pilot]], [[Han Solo]], in [[Mos Eisley]], and Solo agreed to take them to Alderaan aboard his ship, the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. The arrangement was discovered by Imperial troops, who attacked the ship before it departed. The ''Millennium Falcon'' blasted its way out of the Mos Eisley [[spaceport]] and evaded two Star Destroyers in orbit. They arrived at the former location of Alderaan after it was [[Destruction of Alderaan|destroyed]] by the Death Star, and they [[Rescue of Princess Leia|rescued]] Organa from Imperial captivity. Though Kenobi was killed by Darth Vader during a duel, the group brought the stolen plans to the [[Great Temple|Rebel base]] on [[Yavin 4]], where Rebel analysts studied them and found a weakness in the battle station's systems. The Rebel forces launched an attack on the Death Star, leading to the [[Battle of Yavin]] and the destruction of the dreaded Imperial superweapon. ==Prelude== {{Quote|My father's revenge. He put a flaw in the Death Star. He put a fuse in the middle of your machine and I've just told the entire galaxy how to light it.|Jyn Erso, to Director Orson Krennic|[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]]}} During the [[Clone Wars]], renowned energy [[scientist]] [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]] was recruited by [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] to research the energy potential of [[kyber crystal]]s for the [[Galactic Republic]]—which, at the end of the war, transformed into the [[Galactic Empire]]. Erso, who initially believed the [[Project Celestial Power|project]] was for benevolent purposes, defected from the Empire in [[17 BBY]] after learning that his research was being used for weapons development.''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]'' He was captured by Krennic in [[13 BBY]] and forced back into Imperial service to build the [[superlaser]] that would power the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], a [[superweapon]] capable of destroying entire [[planet]]s. Erso used this as an opportunity to add a vulnerability into the Death Star's reactor, which, if triggered by pressurized explosions, would destroy the [[battle station]]. He set off a series of events that led to his daughter, [[Jyn Erso]], and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] learning of the flaw. [[File:TantiveEscape.jpg|thumb|right|280px|The ''Tantive IV'' escaping from Scarif with the plans]] Although Galen's treason was discovered and he was killed in the crossfire of the [[mission to Eadu]], Erso and [[Captain]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] of [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service]] soon led a team called [[Rogue One]] to steal the [[Death Star plans]] and discover the vulnerability during the [[Battle of Scarif]]. Erso, Andor, and the Rogue One unit were all killed during the battle, but not before Erso was able to transmit the plans to the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] that was engaged with Imperial forces above [[Scarif]]. The plans were intercepted by the [[MC75 Star Cruiser]] flagship ''[[Profundity]]'', which the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'' was docked within for repairs.{{StoryCite|story=Raymus|book=From a Certain Point of View}} The [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] boarded ''Profundity'' and slaughtered a host of Rebel soldiers as he attempted to recover the plans, but the Rebel forces passed the information on a data tape to [[Toshma Jefkin]], [[second officer]] of the ''Tantive IV''. The plans were given to [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan]], a member of the [[Imperial Senate]] and a leader in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who was aboard the vessel. Organa was tasked by her father, [[Bail Prestor Organa]], to bring the plans to the planet [[Tatooine]], a world that only possessed a minor [[Tatooine garrison|Imperial presence]], and [[Hunt for Obi-Wan|protected]] Leia from Imperial agents{{Kenobi|Part VI}} in [[9 BBY]].{{KenobiDate|VI}} Vader pursued the ''Tantive IV'' aboard his [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Devastator]]'', and followed the ship to Tatooine. While most trips into hyperspace left a ship unable to be tracked, the damage to the hyperdrive aboard the ''Tantive IV'' left a unique energy signature behind it. As the maintenance crew knew, the Empire would easily be able to follow the ''Tantive IV'' to its destination if they had managed to lock onto that energy signature. Understanding that danger, Organa ordered the ship go directly to Tatooine instead of heading back to the [[Great Temple|Rebel base]] on the moon of [[Yavin 4]]. In secret, one of the droids aboard, the [[Protocol droid|protocol unit]] [[U-3PO]], also happened to be an unwitting Imperial spy, giving the Empire another way to track the ship by following the droid's signal. Through both the faulty hyperdrive subsystem and secret spy droid, the ''Devastator'' followed the fleeing rebel ship. ==The battle== ===Firefight on ''Tantive IV''=== {{Quote|Don't act so surprised, your highness. You weren't on any mercy mission this time. Several transmissions were beamed to this ship by Rebel spies. I want to know what happened to the plans they sent you.''"''
''"''I don't know what you're talking about. I am a member of the Imperial Senate on a diplomatic mission to Alderaan.''"''
''"''You are a part of the Rebel Alliance and a traitor. Take her away!|Princess and Senator Leia Organa and Lord Vader|}} [[File:DevastatorTantiveIV.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Devastator'' pursues the ''Tantive IV''.]] Less than an [[Standard hour|hour]] later, the ''Tantive IV'' arrived in [[orbit]] of Tatooine, with the ''Devastator'' in close pursuit. Eight [[minutes]] from its destination, the corvette's [[hyperdrive motivator]] gave out and the Star Destroyer caught up and overpowered it, knocking out its main reactor, before drawing the small ship into its lower hangar.{{StoryCite|story=Raymus|book=From a Certain Point of View}} During the pursuit, [[Lieutenant]] [[Ciena Ree]] was the officer responsible for activating the [[tractor beam]] that drew the ''Tantive IV'' into the ''Devastator''{{'s}} hangar. As the ''Tantive IV'' was being pulled into the ''Devastator'', the corvette continued to broadcast protests that it was on a "diplomatic mission." This was ignored by Ree and the other Imperial officers. Darth Vader then issued the order to board the ''Tantive IV''.''[[Lost Stars]]'' Meanwhile, [[Rebel trooper]]s, [[Ensign]] [[Cariso Smadis]] among them,{{ForceCollection|Cariso Smadis|star=2}} prepared for their ship to be boarded, taking positions in the hallway near the entrance from which the Imperials would enter. Deploying from a [[TIE boarding craft]],[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]] [[stormtrooper]]s of Vader's personal [[501st Legion]] breached the port airlock of the ''Tantive IV'' and commenced their boarding action. They cut down the door and it exploded outward, and the Imperial forces swarmed into the halls of the ''Tantive IV''. The Rebels were quickly overwhelmed, and the ship quickly fell under Imperial control. Captain [[Raymus Antilles]] was captured along with several surviving rebels and droids. While the ship was being boarded, four of the rebel crew attempted to escape in a [[Escape pod|pod]] but the Imperials shot it down. The boarding party would bring its own astromech droids, [[R2-Q2]] and [[R4-M9]],{{KotoCite|set=ARTFX+|pack=R2-Q2|url=https://en.kotobukiya.co.jp/product/product-0000002283}}{{KotoCite|set=ARTFX+|pack=R4-M9|link=R4-M9-Celebration-Exclusive-ARTFX-plus-Kotobukiya.asp}} to search the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} computers for the plans. U-3PO would be detained and checked, but no helpful information recovered. [[File:JackGregory-BoardingParty.png|thumb|right|300px|Rebel troopers and incoming stormtroopers exchange fire aboard the ''Tantive IV''.]] The stormtroopers checked the vessel's main computer and found that there was no trace of the Death Star plans. The plans were in the princess' hands, and she uploaded them into the memory banks of the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]], who belonged to her father and Antilles.{{Film|III}} In addition to the plans, she recorded a [[Hologram|holographic]] message for Kenobi introducing herself and telling him that her father had requested that he come to the assistance of the Rebellion. She begged him to help and to bring the Death Star plans to her father on Alderaan, saying that Kenobi was the Rebellion's only hope. She ended her recording and sent R2 on his mission. The droid, along with protocol droid [[C-3PO]], made his way to an escape pod, intent on delivering the plan and message to the Jedi Master. Meanwhile, Darth Vader, who had boarded the ship soon after the attack began, interrogated the captured Antilles by choking him with his bare hands. The Dark Lord demanded to know where to find the Death Star plans, but Antilles claimed that the ship had not intercepted any transmissions and that it was simply a consular vessel on a diplomatic mission. Antilles, having proven he would not talk, had his neck crushed by the Dark Lord. Tossing the captain's dead body aside, Vader ordered his stormtroopers to begin tearing the ''Tantive IV'' apart until the plans could be found, further declaring that all passengers were to be captured and brought before him. The stormtroopers continued their search as ordered. One group under [[Stormtrooper Commander]] [[TK-9091]] located the princess; the commander was fatally shot by Organa after announcing his find, but [[Tarvyn Lareka|TK-4601]] succeeding in stunning and capturing the princess. As the princess was taken prisoner, Artoo and Threepio boarded an escape pod and ejected it from the ship, bound for Tatooine. Imperial gunners aboard the ''Devastator'' noticed that the escape pod had been jettisoned but were ordered by the [[gunnery captain]] [[Bolvan]] to hold their fire, who assured his [[chief gunnery captain]], [[Hija]], that the escape pod had likely short-circuited — Bolvan's true reasonings were more selfish, as destroying a plausibly empty escape pod would not count as a successful kill and thus negatively impact his chances at promotion.{{StoryCite|story=The Sith of Datawork|book=From a Certain Point of View}} [[File:TakeHerAway-ANH.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Vader interrogates the princess.]] As the droids escaped, [[TK-3338]], [[TK-4247]], and TK-4601 brought Organa before Vader. She denied any involvement in the Rebel Alliance, claiming instead that she was on a diplomatic mission to Alderaan and that the Imperial Senate would not be pleased with what Vader had done to the vessel. The Dark Lord ordered the princess to be taken away, and was then informed by Commander [[Praji]] that the Death Star plans were not aboard the vessel. He also learned of the escape pod and dispatched a [[Unidentified sandtrooper regiment|stormtrooper regiment]] to retrieve them, bringing the full might of the Empire onto Tatooine. The [[Tatooine garrison]] was also ordered to search for the droids. On the surface below, the [[Lars homestead|Lars moisture farm]] sat, where [[moisture farmer]] [[Owen Lars]] lived with his [[Marriage|wife]] [[Beru Whitesun Lars|Beru]] and their nephew [[Luke Skywalker]]—who was secretly the son of Darth Vader and the [[twin]] brother of Princess Organa.{{Film|VI}} Skywalker had in fact seen the battle over Tatooine whilst working on the family farm.{{Databank|wed-treadwell-droid|WED Treadwell Droid}} Later, he told his friends as such at [[Tosche Station]], only for [[Biggs Darklighter]], looking up with his friend's [[macrobinoculars]], to notice the ships were sitting still by that point.{{Databank|biggs-darklighter-biography-slideshow|Biggs Darklighter Biography Slideshow}} {{C|Slide 2}} Darklighter then confided in his friend that he was deserting the Empire to join the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps]]{{Databank|biggs-darklighter-biography-slideshow|Biggs Darklighter Biography Slideshow}} {{C|Slide 4}} before leaving.{{Databank|biggs-darklighter-biography-slideshow|Biggs Darklighter Biography Slideshow}} {{C|Slide 5}} ===Reunion aboard the ''Devastator''=== {{Quote|I wanted to say, I'm sorry about your princess. You must feel so ... betrayed.''"
"''Princess Leia can only have been misled by her courtiers. I feel sure that a thorough investigation will clear her of any real wrongdoing.|Lieutenants [[Ciena Ree]] and [[Nash Windrider]] responding to news of Princess Leia's arrest|}} [[File:The_Courier_Intercepted.jpg|thumb|300px|right|Princess Leia was brought aboard the ''Devastator'' after the fall of the ''Tantive IV''.]] Following the boarding of the ''Tantive IV'', Organa was brought aboard the ''Devastator'' for transport to the Death Star as a prisoner. Processing the captured ''Tantive IV'' became the priority for [[fleet logistics liaison]] [[Arvira]]. However, at some point during the work Arvira was interrupted by Bolvan, who had realized his error in sparing the escape pod as there were no signs of the plans aboard the ''Tantive IV'', which made him realize they were likely aboard the pod. At Arvira's guidance, he agreed to file [[Form INS-776-TX]] for an armament inspection on the ''Devastator'' to keep Hija occupied and out of the way of anyone who would question him on the inaction. Meanwhile, Ciena Ree delivered the auxiliary bridge's hard data files to the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] internal affairs officer Captain [[Ronnadam]]. On the way, she encountered a fellow Imperial officer Nash Windrider, a native of Alderaan. Both were privy to the details of an Imperial search mission being sent to Tatooine to find the stolen Death Star plans but expressed relief that they had not been dispatched to the hot, desert world. When Ree apologized for the discovery of Princess Leia's treason, Nash opined that she had been misled by her courtiers and expressed his hopes that a thorough investigation would clear her of any real wrongdoing. Ciena took the [[Turbolift|lift]] to the heart of the ''Devastator'' where she was greeted by Captain Ronnadam. At that point, [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] appeared via hologram and chastised Ronnadam for his lax protocols and bad manners. At that point, Lieutenant Ree recognized Tarkin as the man who had befriended her and fellow cadet [[Thane Kyrell]] when they were eight-[[Standard year|year]]-olds living on [[Jelucan]]. The Moff recognized Ree from that encounter and expressed his delight that his "diplomacy" had led Ree and her friend to join the Imperial Navy. Pleased with Ree and Kyrell's achievements at the Royal Imperial Academy, Tarkin remarked that she should recruit more people from Jelucan in the future. ===Search for the droids=== {{Quote|General Kenobi. Years ago you served my father in the Clone Wars. Now he begs you to help him in his struggle against the Empire. I regret that I am unable to convey my father's request to you in person, but my ship has fallen under attack, and I'm afraid my mission to bring you to Alderaan has failed. I have placed information vital to the survival of the Rebellion into the memory systems of this R2 unit. My father will know how to retrieve it. You must see this droid safely delivered to him on Alderaan. This is our most desperate hour. Help me, Obi-Wan Kenobi. You're my only hope.|Princess and Senator Leia Organa, in her message to Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=Leiamessage.flac|}} [[File:Stormtrooper_Search.png|thumb|left|250px|Sandtroopers search for the Death Star plans before discovering they were taken by droids]] The droids' escape pod landed in the desert wastes of Tatooine, far from any form of civilization. R2-D2 and C-3PO left the pod, with 3PO not knowing what planet they were on or what R2's true mission was. Unclear as to which direction to head in, the droids argued about where to go before splitting up over their disagreement; R2 set off on his own, intent on finding Kenobi, while 3PO left in the opposite direction. 3PO wandered in the desert before spotting a [[sandcrawler]], the type of vehicle used by [[Jawa]] scavengers. He was picked up by the [[Nebit's tribe|tribe]] of Jawas and fitted with a [[restraining bolt]], as the Jawas planned on selling him as well as the many other droids in their vehicle. Later, R2 faced similar circumstances in the [[Jundland Wastes]]. While making his way through a canyon, he was discovered by the same Jawas, who stunned him with an [[ion blaster]] and brought him aboard the crawler, where the two droids reunited. Meanwhile, the Empire continued their search for the missing plans, with a [[Unidentified sandtrooper captain|sandtrooper captain]] and his forces locating the escape pod. The [[Desert stormtrooper|sandtrooper]] [[Davin Felth]]{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2019/4/8/dominate-the-desert|text=Dominate the Desert}} discovered a part that had fallen off from C-3PO's knee joint.''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' This put the Empire on the trail of the two droids. The morning after the droids were captured by the Jawas, the sandcrawler arrived at the Lars moisture farm, where they were greeted by Owen and his nephew. Owen and Skywalker inspected what the Jawas had for sale and (after reconsidering a [[R5-D4|white-and-red]] [[R5 series astromech droid]]) ultimately purchased Artoo and Threepio, with Owen intending to use them as farm workers. While Skywalker was cleaning them, he discovered a partial version of the princess' message for Kenobi. Although Skywalker had never heard the name Obi-Wan Kenobi, he did know of a Ben Kenobi who lived beyond the Dune Sea, and was unaware that they were the same person. Skywalker told his aunt and uncle what he had discovered, and Owen let slip that Kenobi knew Skywalker's father, then-known as Anakin Skywalker. Owen claimed, however, that the two died around the same time, though Kenobi was still very much alive. While Skywalker was speaking with his family about the message, R2 escaped from the farm to find the Jedi Master. The next morning, Skywalker and 3PO quietly left the farm to locate R2. While they were gone, the Empire traced the droids to the Jawas and massacred the sandcrawler's crew, trying to disguise their attack as a [[Tusken Raider]] ambush. Using the intelligence gathered at the sandcrawler, the Empire tracked the droids to the Lars homestead, where the sandtrooper captain interrogated Owen and Beru as his troops searched the homestead. Learning that Skywalker had the droids, the captain suspected the boy to be a rebel sympathizer and sent some of his troopers to locate him despite believing they would fail. The stormtroopers then murdered the Lars couple and burned their home to keep the search for the droids a secret. The stormtroopers left their charred corpses amongst the burning ruins of the farm. Skywalker and 3PO, meanwhile, found R2 in the [[Jundland Wastes]] but were attacked by a trio of Tusken Raiders, [[A'Koba]], [[A'Vor]], and [[A'Vor's twin]].{{StoryCite|story=Rites|book=From a Certain Point of View}} Skywalker was knocked unconscious and C-3PO was damaged falling over in surprise. Soon thereafter, however, Kenobi arrived and scared off the Raiders off by imitating the cry of a [[krayt dragon]],{{InsiderCite|216|Forces of Nature: The Wild Spaces and Wilder Creatures of the Star Wars Galaxy|Forces of Nature: The Wild Spaces and Wilder Creatures of the ''Star Wars'' Galaxy}} a type of beast that lived in the desert. The trio of Tusken Raiders had been warned of Kenobi, who was described as a [[shaman]] who controlled the air itself, by [[Chief]]tain [[A'Yark]]. As the Raiders and their [[bantha]] beasts left, Skywalker came to and told Kenobi about the droid and its mission, and the Jedi Master admitted that he was, indeed, Obi-Wan Kenobi. Correctly deducing the Tuskens intended to return in greater numbers, he quickly marshalled for Luke, R2-D2 and the damaged C-3PO to leave with him. [[File:Leias_message.png|thumb|right|250px|R2-D2 plays the princess' message.]] Kenobi brought Skywalker and the droids to [[Ben Kenobi's home|his home]], where C-3PO was repaired and Kenobi explained that he was once a [[Jedi Knight]] and that he had fought in the Clone Wars alongside Anakin. He gave the boy [[Skywalker lightsaber|Anakin's lightsaber]] and claimed that Anakin had been murdered by Darth Vader. The two then watched the full message that Artoo had brought for the Jedi Master. Kenobi resolved to bring the plans to Alderaan and asked Skywalker to go with him, but the boy refused. After discovering the ruins of the sandcrawler and the bodies of the crew, Skywalker, ignoring Kenobi's warnings, fled back home to help his family. Skywalker discovered that his family too had been murdered by Imperial stormtroopers.''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' Meanwhile, Kenobi spoke to the [[Force spirit]] of his master, [[Qui-Gon Jinn]], who eased Kenobi's worries that Skywalker may find danger by declaring Kenobi would rescue him if the boy found danger.{{StoryCite|story=Master and Apprentice (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View}} With his family gone, Skywalker returned to Kenobi, agreeing to go to Alderaan and to be trained as a Jedi, as his father once was. ===Escape from Mos Eisley=== {{Quote|What's the cargo?''"''
''"''Only passengers. Myself, the boy, two droids—and no questions asked.''"''
''"''What is it? Some kind of local trouble?''"''
''"''Let's just say we'd like to avoid any Imperial entanglements.|Captain [[Han Solo]] and [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|}} Meanwhile, a [[Kubaz]] informant named [[Garindan ezz Zavor]], who had resolved to raise the [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] needed to travel back to his homeworld of [[Kubindi]], decided to take up the Empire's request to find the droids. Even though he intended to free Kubindi from [[Blockade of Kubindi|Imperial rule]] and had nearly been [[brain]]washed by the regime, he had become a source for the Empire's operations on Tatooine to secure the funds he needed. In the [[Mos Eisley market place]], the Kubaz spy met an [[Unidentified artist|artist]], who came to write of their encounter in his [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]], before meeting with a unit of stormtroopers who had previously been questioning locals about the droids they were looking for. The artist, who could have possibly been the [[Ithorian]] [[Gammit Chond]], deduced that Zavor was in their employ.''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]'' Famed [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] also tried to locate the droids, wanting to bring them to Vader to make up for a time when he had disintegrated three rebel spies the Sith Lord had wanted alive.{{StoryCite|story=Added Muscle|book=From a Certain Point of View}} [[File:Not-The-Droids.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker and Kenobi are stopped and questioned about the droids]] Knowing that they would need to charter passage to Alderaan for themselves and the droids, Skywalker, Kenobi, and the droids made their way to the spaceport settlement of [[Mos Eisley]] on Skywalker's [[landspeeder]]. Imperial forces had already arrived in the city to inspect the area for the droids. After being spotted by [[Foot Patrol 7]], Skywalker's landspeeder was stopped by the sandtroopers, and the group was questioned about the droids they were carrying. In order to avoid further questioning, Kenobi used a [[mind trick]] to convince the soldiers that R2 and 3PO were not the droids they were looking for. With the soldiers entirely convinced by the mind trick, the group was able to evade Imperial suspicions and make their way further into Mos Eisley. To find a charter, Kenobi and Skywalker made their way into [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], while the droids were forced to wait outside; the establishment had a rule about not serving droids, and the two [[human]]s didn't want to cause any trouble or draw any further suspicion. However, their attempt to blend in backfired; it only made them seem more suspicious, as was noted by [[Ickabel G'ont]], a member of the band [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]], who were playing at the Cantina at the time.{{StoryCite|story=Not for Nothing|book=From a Certain Point of View}} Anyone who didn't notice the two soon did when Skywalker got in an altercation with [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]], which Kenobi flashily ended with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber|his lightsaber]]. Due to being forced to wait outside, R2 and 3PO were left in the open. In order to avoid questioning and potential capture from the stormtroopers, the droids hid inside a building and narrowly escaped attention from stormtroopers who were inspecting the area. Kenobi, meanwhile, met [[Chewbacca]], the first mate and co-[[pilot]] aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. The [[Wookiee]] introduced the Jedi Master and Skywalker to the [[YT-1300 light freighter|freighter's]] captain, [[Han Solo]], and Kenobi questioned Solo as to whether the ''Falcon'' would be a suitable vessel to make it to Alderaan without Imperial detection. After Solo boasted about his vessel's [[Raid on Kessel|accomplishments]] and speed, Kenobi negotiated for Solo to bring them to Alderaan for a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard|money]]—money that Solo, a [[smuggler]], needed in order to pay off debts he owed to [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]]. With their passage to Alderaan secured, Skywalker sold his speeder to a [[Vuvrian]] [[merchant]] named [[Wioslea]]''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' for two thousand credits''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' in order to make enough money for the initial payment. On the way to the ''Falcon'', which was docked in [[Docking Bay 94]], he and Kenobi confronted a stormtrooper who asked for their identification. Kenobi quickly ignited his lightsaber and sliced through his [[E-11 medium blaster rifle]]. Kenobi then [[Telekinesis|used the Force]] to drop a piece of metal onto the trooper's head, knocking him unconscious. Kenobi noticed that the Imperials had expanded their search for the droids, so they hastened their pace towards the docking bay.[[Star Wars (LINE Webtoon)|''Star Wars'' LINE Webtoon]] They soon reunited with the droids and discussed their plan to meet Solo at the ''Falcon''. Their conversation was overheard by Zavor, the very same informant whom had met the artist. The spy told a group of stormtroopers where Skywalker and Kenobi were headed. By this point, the garrison had already begun looking for them after a report from a [[Garouf Lafoe|witness]] of the altercation in the cantina. Hoping to capture the group before their escape, the troopers made their way towards the bay. [[File:Falcon-tatooine.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' leaves Tatooine.]] The group met Solo in Docking Bay 94 and began boarding the ''Millennium Falcon''. As they prepared to leave, the stormtroopers swarmed into the bay and fired on the group and the ship. Solo fired back before boarding, and he ordered Chewbacca to take off immediately. The ''Falcon'' left the bay and quickly sped out of Mos Eisley and off of the planet. When he saw the ''Falcon'' escape, stormtrooper [[Sardis Ramsin|TD-7556]] decided to desert the [[Imperial Army]]. Once in orbit, the ''Falcon'' was pursued by three Imperial Star Destroyers. Solo and Chewbacca piloted the ship with evasive actions, while Solo plotted the course to Alderaan in the [[navigation computer]]. The ship took enemy fire as the course was calculated, but soon enough the ship made the jump into [[hyperspace]], escaping Tatooine with a course set for Alderaan. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|We've captured a freighter entering the remains of the Alderaan system. Its markings match those of a ship that blasted its way out of Mos Eisley.''"''
''"''They must be trying to return the stolen plans to the princess. She may yet be of some use to us.|An Imperial officer and Lord Vader, to [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]|}} As the ''Millennium Falcon'' made its way to Alderaan, Organa was interrogated aboard the Death Star, where she was taken after her capture. The Empire wanted to learn the location of the Rebel base—the [[Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4]]—but Organa refused to provide the information. In an attempt to coerce the information from her, Grand Moff Tarkin, who had become [[Governor]] of the Outer Rim and commander of the Death Star, threatened to destroy Alderaan if she did not comply. Organa provided a false location, claiming that the base was on the planet [[Dantooine]]—while the Rebellion's [[Dantooine base|first base]] indeed had been there, it was since abandoned.{{Databank|dantooine|Dantooine}} Though Tarkin believed her, he carried out the operation in order to demonstrate the station's firepower to [[the galaxy]]. With a single shot from the station's superlaser, [[Destruction of Alderaan|Alderaan was destroyed]]. Tarkin later learned from Imperial scouts that the Rebel base was not located on Dantooine. Ree and Kyrell's favorable perceptions of the Empire were challenged by the destruction of Alderaan. Nash was devastated by the destruction of his homeworld but renewed his devotion to the Empire. [[File:Leiadeathstar.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker, Organa, and Solo, during their escape from the Death Star]] The ''Millennium Falcon'' arrived to find the [[The Graveyard|remains of Alderaan]], now an asteroid field that Han remarked wasn't on any of his charts. Chasing a lone [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE Fighter]] that seemed to appear from nowhere, the Falcon was pulled into the Death Star by a tractor beam, one that needed to be deactivated in order for the group to escape. The group infiltrated the Death Star and set out on separate missions: Kenobi located and deactivated the tractor beam, while Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca made their way to Death Star's detention level to [[Rescue of Princess Leia|rescue]] Organa once they learned she was aboard. Together with the princess, the group fought against Imperial forces and escaped the detention level. Kenobi, meanwhile, came face to face with Darth Vader in a final [[Lightsaber combat|confrontation]] between the one-time Master and [[Padawan]]. The others returned to the ''Millennium Falcon'' where they saw Kenobi fighting Vader. To allow the group to escape, Kenobi sacrificed himself; Vader killed the Jedi Master, and Kenobi became [[Force spirit|one]] with [[the Force]]. Having escaped the Death Star, the ''Millennium Falcon''—upon which the Empire, on Vader's suggestion, had placed a [[homing beacon]] to track the vessel—destroyed pursing [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s and made its way to the Great Temple. Organa delivered the stolen Death Star plans to the Alliance, and [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] presented a plan for how the Rebels could destroy the Death Star with a single [[proton torpedo]] shot into a two-[[meter]]-wide exhaust port. This led to the [[Battle of Yavin]], with Rebel fighter squadrons fighting their way through Imperial defenses in an attempt to reach the exhaust port. Skywalker, piloting a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]], was the only starfighter to reach the exhaust port. He was pursued by Darth Vader, but Vader and his flanking TIE fighters were fought off by the ''Millennium Falcon''. Skywalker fired the shot that destroyed the Death Star, and he, Solo, and Chewbacca were hailed as heroes. Exploiting the fatal flaw in the Death Star's designs proved to be the late Galen Erso's revenge against the Empire, and it honored the sacrifice made by Jyn Erso, Cassian Andor, and the rest of Rogue One. After many years had passed, a [[Unidentified Whill|Whill]] tasked with recording key events of the galaxy believed that this mission was an appropriate starting point to deliver the story of the vast
